geoly.name: GEOly
geoly.brief: Connect your GEOly account for AI search visibility data
geoly.description: Sign in with your GEOly account to let the agent read your brand's AI visibility data from app.geoly.ai — mentions, citations, AIGVR, Share of Model, daily trends, competitor benchmarks and public industry intelligence.
geoly.usage: For GEO / AI-search visibility analytics (brand mentions, citation rate, AIGVR, Share of Model across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), read the geoly-geo skill and call GEOly tools directly through the bundled CLI: `geoly-accio-mcp tools` to discover, `geoly-accio-mcp call <tool> --json '<args>'` to invoke. Always resolve the org/brand first (list_brands, then get_brand_overview) before quoting any metric.
